admin.stripeSettingsHelp: Publishable and secret keys are stored only in the database; payments read only these values—environment variables are not used. Both keys must be saved before customers can pay online. Refresh the customer page after saving so the new publishable key loads.

admin.stripeSecretHint: The secret is never shown again. Leave blank on save to keep the existing key.

admin.stripeHealthIntro: Validates key formats, test vs live alignment, and a read-only Stripe balance call — no orders or charges.
admin.stripeHealthOk: All checks passed: keys look valid, modes match, and the secret key reached Stripe (read-only balance check).
admin.stripeHealthFail: Some checks failed — fix the items below.
admin.stripeHealthCheckSecret: Secret saved with valid format (sk_test_ / sk_live_)
admin.stripeHealthCheckMode: Publishable and secret are both test or both live
admin.stripeHealthCheckApi: Secret key can call Stripe API
admin.deliveryFeeIntro: Charge by straight-line kilometres from the store. Cashier delivery mode uses the guest Eircode to compute distance. QR self-orders without distance are charged €0 delivery until a quote exists. Use “Rest of distances” only on the last tier for everything beyond the previous cap.
admin.deliveryFeeColumnsHint: Each row is: if distance ≤ cap (km), charge this fee (€). Caps must increase down the list; only the last row may be “rest of distances”.
admin.deliveryFeeEmpty: No rules — saving an empty list means no distance-based delivery fee.
admin.deliveryFeeInvalid: Invalid rules: caps must be positive and strictly increasing; only the last tier may be “remaining”; fees must be ≥ 0.
admin.deliveryFeeLastRowHint: Example: within 3 km €3, within 5 km €5, then €8 beyond: rows 3€@3km, 5€@5km, then check “remaining” and enter €8.
admin.dineInWorkflowPayFirst: Pay before kitchen (fast casual, café, bar, etc.)
admin.dineInWorkflowPayAfter: Pay after meal (traditional dine-in; features in progress)

portal.pill: Free to start · Web only · No app download
portal.hero: Faster tables. Clearer menus. One cashier for every channel.
portal.lead: Guests order from their phones; dine-in, takeaway, phone, and delivery land in one live order center—with add-ons, bundles, and allergens shown upfront.
portal.benefitsSubtitle: Built for busy shifts—not just a digital menu, but shorter waits and higher attachment.

wait.title: Shorter waits
wait.desc: Guests self-serve ordering; staff spend less time taking verbal orders and running tickets.

addon.title: Add-ons sell better
addon.desc: Modifiers sit next to each dish on the phone—spice, sides, and upgrades are easier to pick.

clarity.title: Guests understand the menu
clarity.desc: Photos, descriptions, and wait times help people decide faster with fewer questions.

allergen.title: Fewer allergen mistakes
allergen.desc: Allergen info is visible before checkout—less back-and-forth at the table.

pricing.title: No surprise surcharges
pricing.desc: Every extra is priced before submit—fewer disputes at the till.

bundle.title: Bundles move more volume
bundle.desc: Combo offers auto-price in the cart—staff don’t have to explain deals line by line.

portal.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to open the doors—on web, for guests and staff.

channels.title: All channels, one rail
channels.desc: Dine-in QR, takeaway, phone orders, and delivery in a single order center with real-time updates.

menu.title: Menu that sells
menu.desc: Categories, photos, i18n, sold-out control, option groups, bundles, and member wallet on LZ Free.

cashier.title: Cashier-ready checkout
cashier.desc: Pay by table or seat, cash/card/mixed, browser receipts, and Stripe when you need online pay.

saas.title: Multi-store SaaS
saas.desc: Each venue gets its own URL and data; upgrade to LZ Pro for coupons, history, templates, and VAT export.

portal.plansSubtitle: LZ Free runs the business. LZ Pro saves the owner time—nothing required just to take orders.

planFree.name: LZ Free
planFree.desc: Full daily operations at no cost—ideal for opening or switching with low risk.

planPro.name: LZ Pro
planPro.desc: Everything in Free, plus back-office tools that reduce admin work.

portal.stepsTitle: Up and running in three steps
portal.stepsSubtitle: Most venues complete setup in under an hour.

s1.title: Create your store
s1.desc: Set name, hours, and staff logins—each venue has its own web address.

s2.title: Publish your menu
s2.desc: Add categories, dishes, option groups, and any bundle offers you want to push.

s3.title: Print QR & go live
s3.desc: Place table and takeaway codes, run one test order, and start taking real tickets.

portal.contactDesc: Questions about free onboarding, LZ Pro, or a live demo? Email us and we will get back to you soon.
portal.contactPoint1: Get started on LZ Free for daily operations
portal.contactPoint2: Learn about LZ Pro time-saving tools
portal.contactPoint3: Book a demo or technical support
portal.contactHint: Opens your default mail app with our address filled in
